rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: LinkedIn Posts Hunter MCP provides AI-powered LinkedIn job post search and tracking through Playwright browser automation with persistent authentication, local SQLite storage, and a React dashboard interface. Built by Kevin Weitgenant, it automates LinkedIn post scraping with configurable pagination and concurrency, stores all data locally for complete privacy, and offers dual control through natural language AI commands or a modern web UI with advanced filtering by keywords, application status, dates, and post IDs. The implementation features automatic authentication detection, concurrent post processing with metadata extraction (author details, engagement metrics, timestamps), and a responsive dashboard with both table and card views that auto-polls for updates, making it valuable for job seekers who want to systematically track and manage LinkedIn opportunities without relying on external services.
